rationale: Spine b (cold set with halving, test ladder, titration, exam-style items). Grafted a's tempting-then-refute feedback wording and its 'Show me why' agency nodes (routed back to the same probe). All stems replacing replays of S1-S7 (airway, ear cartilage, pair items, CO oximeter) were rewritten as new vignettes; c's black-stain/low-sodium picture-to-agent form used for the topical-agent probe. Twelve probes, hints on the first six, cold on the last six; option lengths balanced so no key is findable by form.
lesson: For a consolidate segment, take the cold-set structure that varies surface forms, but rewrite every stem that echoes earlier segments, and add agency explanations to wrong picks without lengthening the path for correct learners.
